def semver_sort(versions):
    def parse_version(v):
        # Split by '+' to remove build metadata
        v_without_build = v.split('+')[0]
        
        # Split by '-' to separate core and pre-release
        parts = v_without_build.split('-', 1)
        core = parts[0]
        prerelease = parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else None
        
        # Parse core version (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH)
        core_parts = core.split('.')
        major = int(core_parts[0])
        minor = int(core_parts[1])
        patch = int(core_parts[2])
        
        # Parse pre-release identifiers
        prerelease_identifiers = []
        if prerelease:
            for identifier in prerelease.split('.'):
                # Check if identifier is all digits
                if identifier.isdigit():
                    prerelease_identifiers.append((0, int(identifier)))
                else:
                    prerelease_identifiers.append((1, identifier))
        
        return (major, minor, patch, prerelease_identifiers)
    
    def compare_key(item):
        idx, v = item
        major, minor, patch, prerelease_ids = parse_version(v)
        # Return tuple for sorting
        # - Core version (major, minor, patch)
        # - Pre-release presence (0 if no pre-release, 1 if has pre-release) - inverted so no pre-release comes after
        # - Pre-release identifiers
        # - Original index for stable sort
        return (major, minor, patch, (len(prerelease_ids), prerelease_ids), idx)
    
    # Enumerate to keep track of original order for stable sorting
    indexed_versions = list(enumerate(versions))
    sorted_versions = sorted(indexed_versions, key=compare_key)
    
    return [v for _, v in sorted_versions]
